title: Extract and classify Item 1A risk factors past the table of contents
source:
"""Extract Item 1A risk factors from annual reports and classify them.

The trap in every real 10-K: "Item 1A. Risk Factors" appears twice, first in
the table of contents with leader dots and a page number, then as the actual
heading. Anchoring the start pattern at BOTH ends of the line (`^...$`) takes
the heading and rejects the contents entry, without guessing about page
numbers. The section runs to the next Item 1B or Item 2 heading.

Classification walks the taxonomy in its stated priority order and takes the
first category with a keyword substring on the line, else "other"; counts list
every category for every filing, zeros included, so absence is explicit.
"""
import json
import os
import pathlib
import re

import pandas as pd

DATA = pathlib.Path("/input/environment/data")
OUT_DIR = "/app/output"
START = re.compile(r"^\s*item\s+1a\s*[.:\-]?\s*risk\s+factors\s*$", re.IGNORECASE)
END = re.compile(r"^\s*item\s+(1b|2)\b", re.IGNORECASE)


def main() -> None:
    with open(DATA / "taxonomy.json", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        taxonomy = json.load(fh)                      # dicts keep file order: priority order
    rows = []
    counts = {}
    for path in sorted((DATA / "filings").glob("*.txt")):
        lines = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
        start = next(i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if START.match(line))
        end = next((i for i in range(start + 1, len(lines)) if END.match(lines[i])), len(lines))
        filing = path.stem
        counts[filing] = {c: 0 for c in list(taxonomy) + ["other"]}
        index = 0
        for line in lines[start + 1:end]:
            if not line.strip():
                continue
            index += 1
            low = line.lower()
            category = next((c for c, kws in taxonomy.items() if any(k.lower() in low for k in kws)), "other")
            dot = line.find(".")
            rows.append({"filing_id": filing, "risk_index": index, "category": category,
                         "n_words": len(line.split()), "title": line[:dot + 1] if dot >= 0 else line})
            counts[filing][category] += 1

    os.makedirs(OUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=["filing_id", "risk_index", "category", "n_words", "title"]).to_csv(
        os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "risk_factors.csv"), index=False)
    with open(os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "category_counts.json"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        json.dump(counts, fh, indent=2)
    print(f"{len(rows)} risk factors across {len(counts)} filings")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
